message.content: ATP synthase (also called F₁F₀‑ATPase) is the enzyme complex embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane that produces ATP. It uses the proton gradient generated by the electron transport chain: protons flow back into the mitochondrial matrix through the F₀ portion, driving rotation of the catalytic F₁ subunit. This mechanical rotation drives the phosphorylation of ADP to ATP (and release of inorganic phosphate). In short, ATP synthase converts the energy stored in the proton motive force into chemical energy stored in ATP, the primary energy currency of the cell.
